title: Personnel changes at Friars Inn: Stitzel, Pollack, Steve Brown
summary: Schoebel and Snyder leave and are replaced by Mel Stitzel, Ben Pollack and Steve Brown, whom he calls the greatest jazz bassist.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
